Elements__Meta.Meta__Description: Every piece of text on this drawing that is not a dimension, a leader or the title block. Authoring keys unchanged, plus Annotation__Lines - the text already broken into the lines it prints as - so the reader never measures a font to decide where a line breaks. Special terms that the editor stores with markdown emphasis are published as the RUNS they print as, because a reader that parses markdown is a reader that can get it wrong.

Elements__Text.Annotation__RunsNote: Annotation__Text keeps the markdown so the document reads back into the editor unchanged. Annotation__Runs is what the reader paints: the emphasis already resolved, per line, so the reader parses nothing. A reader that runs a markdown regex over client-facing text is a reader that will one day eat an asterisk that belonged to a dimension.
